nodes.title: ArduPilot master source: quadplane.cpp, tailsitter.cpp, Parameters.cpp, AP_MotorsMulticopter.cpp, AC_WPNav.cpp, AP_FixedWing.h
nodes.note: parameter names, units, ranges; output_motor_mask(): diff = roll_factor * rudder_dt * 0.5; AIRSPEED_MIN/MAX are AP_Int16; Q_M_SPIN_MAX documented range 0.9-1.0

nodes.title: Differential-thrust mixing in fixed-wing flight
nodes.text: Per-motor output = throttle + roll_factor * rudder_dt * 0.5 with Quad-X roll factors normalised to +/-0.5, so full rudder moves each motor by 0.25 x RUDD_DT_GAIN/100
nodes.basis: SRC-F4-AP-SRC AP_MotorsMulticopter::output_motor_mask and AP_MotorsMatrix::normalise_rpy_factors

nodes.title: Fixed-wing motor output bypasses Q_M_SPIN_MAX
nodes.text: In fixed-wing flight the tailsitter sends throttle to the motors through output_motor_mask(); whether that path applies thrust_to_actuator() (Q_M_SPIN_MIN/MAX, Q_M_THST_EXPO) is not settled from source here. F4 uses the higher of the two outputs (pass-through or linearised) for every speed and rpm cap; the two agree within 0.01 at THR_MAX 70
nodes.basis: tailsitter.cpp output(), AP_MotorsMulticopter::output_motor_mask(); SITL S4 logs RCOU at FW full throttle and settles which path the build uses

nodes.title: Level-flight top speed scales with motor output
nodes.text: At the top of the level-speed range the 11x5.5 prop runs near its pitch speed, so rpm ~ output x pack voltage and VMAX ~ rpm; B1's VMAX at 9 350 rpm (output 0.849 on 16.8 V) scales by output
nodes.basis: team/B1/CHANGE-REQUESTS.md CR-B1-17 (7 950 rpm -> 21.8 m/s, 8 000 -> 21.9, 8 590 -> 23.6: ~linear); first full-throttle level log (H2) replaces it

nodes.title: Thrust varies with output squared
nodes.text: Static thrust per motor T = k a^2, with k from the hover point (Q_M_THST_HOVER)
nodes.basis: rpm ~ duty x V and T ~ rpm^2; good to ~10 % between 0.2 and 0.85 output; the stand replaces it

nodes.title: Station -> motor number -> rotation, and cant sense
nodes.equation: copter fwd = -z, right = +y; motor n where atan2(right, fwd) = AP angle; cant side force along the tangent that turns the airframe like the prop reaction torque

nodes.title: Airspeed limits against stall, transition gate, VA and Vmax
nodes.equation: f_min = AIRSPEED_MIN / Vs ; f_cr = AIRSPEED_CRUISE / (1.3 Vs) ; Vs_keep = AIRSPEED_MIN / 1.3 (largest measured stall that keeps AIRSPEED_MIN, D-71)

nodes.title: Elevon schedule: steady dive at the pitch floor, speed scaler at VA and VD
nodes.equation: CD0 = CL_c/LD - k CL_c^2 ; W sin(theta) = q S CD0 + W^2 k /(q S) -> V_dive ; s(V) = max(min(0.5, SCALING_SPEED/(2 AIRSPEED_MAX)), SCALING_SPEED / V)

nodes.title: Highest level speed at THR_MAX against the VH that VD 27.2 m/s assumes
nodes.equation: a_pass = THR_MAX/100 ; a_lin = s_min + (s_max - s_min) (sqrt((1-e)^2 + 4 e THR_MAX/100) - (1-e)) / (2 e) ; a = max(a_pass, a_lin) ; V_lvl = VMAX(9 350 rpm) x a / a(9 350 rpm) ; VH_req = VD / 1.25 ; r = V_lvl / VH_req (fresh pack: worst case, voltage scaling 1)

nodes.title: Hover rate-loop crossover per axis (rigid body, upper-bound thrust)
nodes.equation: K = 2 T arm / I (mixer factors +/-0.5, four motors) ; |L(jw)| = K sqrt(P^2 + D^2 w^2) / w = 1 -> w = K P / sqrt(1 - K^2 D^2) ; P ceiling = w_max sqrt(1/K^2 - D^2), w_max per axis

nodes.title: Gyro and D-term low-pass over the top of the torsion band
nodes.equation: r = min(INS_GYRO_FILTER, Q_A_RAT_RLL/PIT_FLTD) / f_torsion_hi

nodes.title: Upper-pair motor output in hover with the pitch-trim split, control reserve and a sagged pack
nodes.equation: T_up/T_mean = 2 s /(1 + s) ; a_up = a_h / sqrt(sag) x sqrt(T_up/T_mean x (1 + d))

nodes.title: Touchdown to motors below spin-min with the RC9 cut

nodes.title: Highest motor output in Q and FW modes

nodes.title: RUDD_DT_GAIN needed for the cruise yaw moment
nodes.equation: T_c = m g /(L/D)/n ; k = (m g / n)/a_h^2 ; a_c = sqrt(T_c/k) ; dT = M/(n y) ; da = dT/(2 k a_c) ; gain = da / 0.25

nodes.title: Fastest commanded vertical descent

nodes.title: SERVO5/6 MIN/MAX for +/-25 deg TE from D6's linkage
nodes.equation: k = 500 us / servo throw ; up = theta_up k ; dn = |theta_dn| k ; right (normal): MAX = TRIM + up, MIN = TRIM - dn ; left (reversed): MIN = TRIM - up, MAX = TRIM + dn ; err = max |set - derived| ; span = max |end - TRIM|
